test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: **Nefew**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is '**Nephew**'.
 
• The word 'nephew' refers to the son of one's brother or sister.
 
• The word is pronounced as '**nef-yoo**'.

Hence, **option 1** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Father **is correctly spelt.
 
• **Niece **is correctly spelt and refers to a daughter of one's brother or sister.
 
• **Uncle **is correctly spelt and refers to the brother of one's father or mother.
